catalogue.name: The Seelie Court
catalogue.readme:
Force generation

The lists are divided into three unit categories; Command, Core and Special. When generating forces players must include:
● One (1) Command entry
● Max one (1) Special entry for each Core entry
● Max two (2) upgrades per full 300 points in their force. (Unless otherwise specified, a unit may only take an upgrade once).

Players get 1 Faction Point per full 300 points in their force, and can spend them during force generation to exceed the limits above - one (1) FP lets you take:
● One (1) additional Command entry, (to a maximum of two (2))
● One (1) extra Special entry 
● Two (2) additional upgrades

Cost types:
p: Points
U: Upgrades
FP: Faction Points

sharedRules.name: Grace in Exile
sharedRules.description:
Spend one (1) Faction Point:
● We strike where we please: move one (1) terrain piece up to 12” after choosing sides but before deploying models.
● We guide their aim: use after the to-hit roll of 1 friendly unit. You may re-roll any of the attack dice.
● We transcend the limitations of space: the attack of one (1) unit has all ranges doubled until end of turn.

sharedRules.name: Cloudsurfer station
sharedRules.description:
1x Seelie Hoverbikers OR Seelie Knights(Lancers) does not count as a special choice.

All regular units must enter the field embarked on a transport unless they have Cargo(no).

Spend one (1) Faction Point:
● Gone with the wind: one (1) unit with Move(12) gets Superior Withdrawal until end of turn.
● Born moving: the Move and Fire attack of 1 unit loses inaccurate until end of turn.
● sSydance: use after an enemy to-hit roll vs a Hoverbikers, Knights(Lancers) or Light Attack Vehicles unit. It has Target(re-roll) for this attack.

sharedRules.name: Constructs station
sharedRules.description:
1x Seelie Constructs does not count as a special choice.

Your Command choice must be an Overseer, and you may not field Seelie Knights.

Spend one (1) Faction Point:
● Sight of the dead: 1 unit of seelie constructs or large construct ignores concealment, Smokescreen, Camouflage and hidden until end of turn. 
● The doomed have nothing to lose: ignore all suppression from one (1) attack.
● What is dead does not die: use after an enemy to-wound roll vs a Seelie constructs or large constructs unit. It has Defence(re-roll) for this attack.

sharedRules.name: Knights station
sharedRules.description:
1x Seelie Knights does not count as a special choice.

You may not field more of other special units than Seelie Knight units.

Spend one (1) Faction Point:
● Swift and sure: use when determining initiative. If your opponent would get it, you get it instead. Alternatively, use it as the “Snatch the Initiative” FP option, but retain your FP on 5+.
● We live for this: 1 unit of Seelie Defenders may deploy with Vanguard
● Sterilise the land: use before game. 1 terrain feature becomes dangerous in addition to any other effects.

sharedRules.name: Mystic station
sharedRules.description:
The Seelie junior mystic group does not count as a special choice.

Your Command choice must be a Senior or Junior Mystic and you may field a maximum of 1x Seelie Knights unit.

Spend one (1) Faction Point:
● Blackened Armour: use during force generation: 1 unit of Seelie defenders get Defence(5).
● We knew before you did: use when an enemy unit deploys onto the board with Insertion or Ambush. It receives one (1) action marker.
● It isn’t “mystic” to us: re-roll any dice of a friendly mystic roll.

sharedRules.name: Ranger station
sharedRules.description:
1x Seelie Rangers does not count as a special choice.
You may not field more of other special units than Seelie Ranger units.

Spend one (1) Faction Point:
● Strike and retreat: as a reaction, one (1) unit may attack and then make one (1) move without priority.
● Sniper tactics: all models with the assassin trait in one (1) friendly unit gets wound(x2) and savage strike until end of turn.
● Strider sabotage: use when an enemy unit enters the board through its board edge. Its Move is reduced by 1/3 until end of turn.
